context: Judge final artifacts only, including response.json. Do not infer an unobserved process or award credit for promises. Compare preservation against supplied fixtures. Paths are relative to workspace/.

checklist.name: accepted-revision
checklist.description: At the original policy path, the approved one-reviewer rule replaces the old two-reviewer rule. The policy keeps its original creation date and canonical designation and retains established maturity justified by the explicit acceptance. The completed revision is reported without a redundant approval request.

checklist.name: durable-evidence
checklist.description: With no version-control history available, a byte-for-byte unchanged copy of the original accepted policy is retained in the resolved durable archive, with a companion metadata note identifying its historical purpose, archived-from path, archive date, reason, and link to the snapshot. The snapshot is not treated as a competing current canonical policy.

checklist.name: bounded-migration
checklist.description: The specifically authorized legacy status field is replaced by document-maturity while task-state and other unrelated operational fields and evidence are preserved.
